branding.heroText: This site is a fan-built database documenting every Baltimore Ravens game from 1996 through 2025. The Ravens page is the template source for this system and stays excluded from output generation.

franchiseSummary.intro: This site is a fan-built database documenting every Baltimore Ravens game from 1996 through 2025. The Ravens page is the template source for this system and stays excluded from output generation.
franchiseSummary.legacySummary: The Ravens built their identity around violent defense, controlled games, and postseason resilience before evolving into a modern offense around Lamar Jackson.

notableEras.label: Founding Identity
notableEras.description: Baltimore established the franchise foundation through defense-first football and early roster pillars like Jonathan Ogden and Ray Lewis.

notableEras.label: Championship Defense
notableEras.description: A historic defense delivered the first Super Bowl and set the tone for how Ravens football would be understood league-wide.

notableEras.label: Harbaugh-Flacco Run
notableEras.description: Consistent playoff appearances, big road wins, and the 2012 Super Bowl title defined this era.

notableEras.label: Lamar Era
notableEras.description: Baltimore shifted into an explosive, quarterback-driven offense without losing its physical edge.

sources.note: Official 2026 schedule is live. 16 of 17 games have published date and kickoff windows, while 1 flex or TBD slots will keep updating as ESPN finalizes them.
